name: Tame Impala

whyMatters.en: One-person psychedelic pop with festival scale: the 2010s rock axis absorbs electronic production and still keeps guitar and arrangement identity.
whyMatters.zh: 一人乐队式迷幻流行，却有音乐节体量：2010s 摇滚主轴吸收电子制作，身份仍落在吉他与编曲上。

note.zh: 卧室迷幻进入主流视野
循环与崩溃：现代迷幻的电台事件

interviewQuotes.text: I just follow what sounds good.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Kevin Parker

lyricQuotes: I feel like I was living for you

shortBio.en: Decisive auteur project for contemporary psychedelic pop.
shortBio.zh: 当代迷幻流行的决定性作者项目。

body.en:
Kevin Parker builds Tame Impala like a private studio weather system that somehow fills fields. Psychedelia returns as soft focus and hard craft—loops, bass bloom, falsetto as neon.

Guitar-band identity survives the laptop decade by learning its tools.
body.zh:
Kevin Parker 把 Tame Impala 建成私人录音室天气系统，却莫名填满户外场地。迷幻以柔焦与硬手艺回来——循环、贝斯绽放、假声当霓虹。

吉他乐队身份熬过笔记本电脑十年，靠的是学会那些工具。

body.en:
Decisive because the modern axis need not choose between rock instrumentation and electronic production. Parker keeps arrangement and guitar DNA while the mix speaks fluent 2010s.

Psychedelic pop stops being revival cosplay and becomes a present-tense hit language.
body.zh:
决定性在于：近代主轴不必在摇滚编制与电子制作之间二选一。Parker 守住编曲与吉他 DNA，混音却说流利的 2010s。

迷幻流行不再是复兴扮相，而成本时代畅销语言。

title.en: Feels Like We Only Go Backwards: soft focus, hard hook
title.zh: Feels Like We Only Go Backwards：柔焦，硬钩子

body.en:
A melody that circles like a thought you cannot finish. Bedroom psychedelia steps into mainstream sight without quitting the swirl.

This is how intimate production becomes public weather.
body.zh:
旋律像一个绕不完的念头打转。卧室迷幻走进主流视野，却不退出漩涡。

亲密制作变成公共天气，是从这里开始。

title.en: Let It Happen: the loop that breaks itself
title.zh: Let It Happen：自我崩坏的循环

body.en:
A long build that glitches on purpose—dancefloor logic colliding with studio accident as drama. Let It Happen is modern psychedelia's radio event: patient, then ruptured.

Electronic courage, still signed by a guitar-band name.
body.zh:
长铺垫，故意故障——舞池逻辑撞上工作室事故，事故即戏剧。Let It Happen 是现代迷幻的电台事件：耐心，然后破裂。

电子勇气，签名仍是吉他乐队名。

title.zh: 六十年代雾，一零年代工具

body.en:
Upstream: psychedelic bass bloom and studio-as-instrument habits. Downstream: pop and indie acts that treat the mix as composition.

Tame Impala sit where rock identity and producer authorship stop pretending they are enemies.
body.zh:
上游：迷幻贝斯绽放与「录音室即乐器」习惯。下游：把混音当作曲的流行与 Indie。

Tame Impala 坐在摇滚身份与制作人作者性停止假扮敌人的位置。

title.en: The quiet architect of loud weather
title.zh: 大声天气的安静建筑师

body.en:
Parker often talks like a studio introvert who accidentally booked a stadium. Quotes nail craft obsession more than rock mythology.

Pin the workbench talk. The spectacle is a side effect of loops done right.
body.zh:
Parker 说话常像误订了体育馆的录音室内向者。金句钉住手艺执念，多于摇滚神话。

钉住工作台谈话。奇观是循环做对了的副作用。

note.en: Psych as dancefloor hypnosis for the streaming age.
note.zh: 流媒体时代的迷幻舞池催眠。
